goal: Report the post code on file for member 40021

params.name: member_no
params.description: supplied by the caller per invocation

locator.why: Read the post code on file for member 40021

steps.intent: Initial visit to observe the application
Enter operator id to sign on
Enter pass code to sign on
Navigate to member lookup to enter member number

target.why: Navigate to member lookup to enter member number

steps.intent: Enter the member number to look up

target.why: Enter the member number to look up

steps.intent: Submit member number to view member record

steps.intent: Open contact details to find post code on file

steps.intent: Read the post code on file for member 40021
